quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE DISPATCH SEGMENTS CHRONOLOGICALLY INTO THEIR SLOTS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Dispatch 151-1] Draft an official mission brief describing the discovery of thermal chimney fields in the Mariana Trench.
options: WE HAVE SUCCESSFULLY DOCUMENTED ACTIVE HYDROTHERMAL CHIMNEYS VENTING SUPERHEATED CHEMICAL PLUMES.
quests.hint: Place the SUBJ: line as the Subject, 'DEAR' as Salutation, 'WE HAVE' as Body, and 'REGARDS' as Sign-Off. (Diving calibration index 151-1)
quests.explanation: A standard scientific dispatch follows a subject header, formal greeting, central briefing statement, and professional signature. [Verified by Academy Dispatch Unit 151].
